title: "the piranesi of food", and the question of what comes next
summary: "Piranesi" is a book title that recurs in the cluster as something members urge each other to read (the image described below matches the novel of that name); in this window @harsimony.bsky.social posted "*fine* I'll read Piranesi." and asked the simcluster to read a book of his choosing in return. On Mon 16 Nov @funferall.bsky.social quote-posted a remark about a "banh mi marketer" with "Hear me out: Piranesi banh mi tie-in promotion" and an image of a mock advertisement (51 likes). A day later, when @shibbi.me gave in and said she would try a banh mi, @norvid-studies.bsky.social quote-posted her with "they're calling it the piranesi of food" (44 likes). @handackett.bsky.social pointed him to the earlier post; he replied "salieri'd a bit at that one". @shimmermathlabs.com then asked what the next food would be, @handackett.bsky.social answered "Cha manao", and she replied that she could find none near her and liked that about it.
